# Job requests and runs

**Role:** reference
**Status:** generated by `femkit schema docs` — do not edit
**Authority:** none of its own; the schema models are the authority for `femkit/data/jobs/files.toml`, every file of a calculation folder, a launch folder and a run; `job.toml`, `prepared.json`, a launch folder's records, each run's records, and a job's address (jobs.md §§ 1–5)

## Catalogue

`femkit/data/jobs/files.toml`: every file of a calculation folder, a launch folder and a run.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `programs` | text | required | the folder of femkit's own programs, by its path from the femkit package: a request's `programs` name theirs in it |
| `files` | table of text → [FileRow](#filerow) | required | each file by its role, the name the jobs domain looks it up by |

## FileRow

One file: its name, where it lies, who writes and reads it, and whether a run holds a copy.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | required | its name; one in angle brackets stands for the files the request or its maker names, `run-NNN` for each run's folder, each `N` a digit of its number |
| `lies` | list of `calculation` \| `launch` \| `run` | required | where it lies: a calculation folder, a launch folder, a run |
| `writer` | text | required | who writes it, the one writer |
| `readers` | list of text | required | who reads it |
| `copied` | boolean | `false` | whether `job launch` copies it from the calculation folder into each run |
| `own` | boolean | `false` | a write of the run's own, made while it runs: what tells how long ago a run last wrote (jobs.md § 5.2, rule 6) |
| `source` | text, optional | — | for a program of femkit's, where `job prepare` copies it from: its path from the femkit package |
| `module` | boolean | `false` | a module femkit's programs run with, beside them: hashed with them into a stage's identity — the monitor, which watches a run and makes nothing, is none (see workflow.md § 4) |
| `document` | text, optional | — | for a record a stage's check writes, the stage programs' document it holds, by its kind (`documents.py`): what a stage's check names it by (see jobs.md § 5.1) |
| `says` | text | required | what it holds |

## JobRequest

`job.toml`: a calculation folder's — one command in one environment — or a launch folder's, a batch's members or a sequence's parts, run in one job (jobs.md §§ 1.2, 2).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | required | the job's name, as a scheduler shows it |
| `environment` | text, optional | — | the environment the command runs in, by name; with `gpus &gt; 0`, its CUDA environment `&lt;name&gt;-cuda` |
| `command` | list of text, optional | — | the command, word by word: its first word resolves inside the environment; `{python}` is the environment's own python |
| `inputs` | list of text | empty | files and folders of the calculation folder the command reads, copied into each run |
| `resources` | [Resources](#resources) | required | what the job asks of the machine, every value stated; a launch folder's are its job's, which every member and part runs within |
| `programs` | list of text | empty | femkit's own programs the command or the check runs, by their names in femkit's programs: `job prepare` copies each in, with the modules it runs with and the monitor |
| `one_process` | boolean | `false` | the command runs one process: it states `ranks = 1`; inside a job that holds more, it runs with its own |
| `outputs` | list of text | empty | what the command promises to leave: once its check passed, each recorded with its SHA-256 and made read-only |
| `check` | list of text, optional | — | the contract's check of what the command left, word by word: run after it, in the same environment and run, it exits 0 when it holds, its last line the reason when it does not |
| `shares` | list of [Share](#share) | empty | files other calculation folders made, read where they were made |
| `members` | list of text, optional | — | a batch's calculation folders, by their paths from its launch folder: run one after another in one job, each in a new run |
| `sequence` | list of text, optional | — | a sequence's parts — batches or calculation folders — by their paths from its launch folder: each launched in turn, inside one job |

## Resources

What a job asks for; nothing about a machine (jobs.md § 2).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ranks` | integer | required | MPI ranks |
| `threads` | integer | required | threads per rank |
| `gpus` | integer | required | GPUs per node, a count; 0 states that none is used |
| `wall` | text, optional | — | wall time, `[D-]HH:MM:SS`; read on a machine with a scheduler |
| `memory` | text, optional | — | memory per node, a whole number with `K`, `M`, `G`, `T` or `P`; read on a machine with a scheduler |
| `partition` | text, optional | — | the queue, on a machine with a scheduler |
| `qos` | text, optional | — | the quality of service, where the record lists one |

## Share

A file another calculation folder made, read where it was made (jobs.md § 2).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `folder` | text | required | the calculation folder that made it, by its path from this one |
| `file` | text | required | the file, one of that folder's outputs: read in its newest run, which must be finished, by its path from the run, checked by its SHA-256 at launch; a command or a check names it `{share:FILE}` |

## Prepared

`prepared.json`, written last by `job prepare` (jobs.md § 3, step 7).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | text | required | the machine record it was prepared for, by name |
| `request` | text | required | the SHA-256 of job.toml as prepared: a launch refuses one changed since |
| `environment` | text, optional | — | the environment its run enters; none for a launch folder |
| `install_fingerprint` | text, optional | — | that environment's install fingerprint, as the record lists it |
| `resources` | [Resources](#resources) | required | the resources resolved |
| `files` | table of text → text | required | each script, program and module it wrote, and machine.toml, with its SHA-256: a launch refuses any changed since |
| `launch` | text, optional | — | for a member of a batch or a part of a sequence, the launch folder it is prepared with, by its path from here |

## Maker

`maker.json`, a launch folder's maker's file: the action that writes it again, which `job status` and a launch refused once it was launched offer, knowing nothing of what wrote it (jobs.md § 1.2).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | [Action](#action) | required | the action that writes the launch folder again |

## Action

Something a person may do: an operation with its request, or a shell line that is no operation — a shell's activation, a scheduler's interactive command — on this machine, or on another, `on`, where a surface writes it as a line for that machine and never runs it. Its line and its effect are its operation's, computed from its call and serialized with it (web.md § 7.2), never stored beside it: an action read back from a file femkit keeps computes them again, from the verbs femkit has then.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | text | required | what a person reads on it |
| `note` | text, optional | — | a remark a command line writes after it |
| `call` | [Call](#call), optional | — | the operation it runs; none for a shell line |
| `shell` | text, optional | — | the line a person types, for what is no operation |
| `fills` | list of [Fill](#fill) | empty | each value still to fill, in the order asked |
| `help` | [Help](#help), optional | — | what it does |
| `on` | text, optional | — | the machine it runs on, by its record's name, where that is not the one the page or the command line runs on: a line for that machine, its request's path fields from the project's folder, never run here; none: this machine (see web.md § 7.2) |

## Call

An operation and its request — the values a fill leaves out are asked for.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | text | required | the operation's name, `study.prep` |
| `request` | table of text → Any | empty | the request's values, as JSON |

## Fill

A value an action still needs, asked of the person before it runs: a request field's whole value.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `field` | text | required | the request field it fills |
| `toml` | `whole`, optional | — | the request takes the value as its TOML text, which the surface writes from what the person gives: one of `whole` |
| `label` | text | required | what the value is |
| `help` | [Help](#help), optional | — | its sentence |
| `json_schema` | table of text → Any | empty | the JSON schema fragment of what it may hold, whole: each definition it names carried with it |
| `example` | text, optional | — | a value that would do, as a command line writes it |
| `required` | boolean | `true` | whether it must be given: a value an action still needs always; a form's field where its request has no default |

## Help

What a person reads beside something they may not understand.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sentence` | text | required | one plain sentence |
| `doc` | [DocRef](#docref), optional | — | where it is defined |

## DocRef

Where something is defined: a document of the repository, a section of it, and that section's link anchor.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document` | text | required | the document's path from the repository's root, `docs/contracts/models.md` |
| `section` | text, optional | — | its section as the reference writes it, `11.1`; none for the whole document |
| `anchor` | text, optional | — | the section's heading's link anchor, read from the document; none when it has no such heading |

## LaunchRecord

`launch.json`, a launch folder's launch record, written by `job launch` (jobs.md § 5.1): when it went, the job, its members or parts in order, and each one's runs once launched.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `time` | text | required | when it went |
| `identity` | text | required | the identity of the machine it was launched from |
| `job` | [Job](#job) | required | the job: the walk's process |
| `listed` | list of [Listed](#listed) | required | its members or parts, in order |

## Job

The job a run rides: on a machine without a scheduler, the process its launch started — the run script, or the walk of the batch or sequence it is a member or a part of.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `host` | text | required | the host it runs on |
| `pid` | integer | required | its process ID |
| `start` | integer | required | its start time, in clock ticks since boot |
| `boot` | text | required | the kernel's boot ID |

## Listed

A launch record's member or part: its folder, and the runs launched of it.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `folder` | text | required | the member or part, by its path from the launch folder |
| `runs` | list of text | empty | each run launched of it, by its path from the launch folder; a sequence's part has none until it is reached |

## Launched

`launched.json`, written by `job launch` once the start succeeded.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `time` | text | required | when it went |
| `identity` | text | required | the identity of the machine it was launched from |
| `job` | [Job](#job) | required | the job it rides: the run script's process, or its walk's |
| `wall` | text, optional | — | the wall a queue job was sent with (plan § 4, M4); a run here is sent with none |

## Started

`started.json`, written by the run script, its first write (jobs.md § 4, block 4): every value the scheduler granted as its variable held it.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `time` | text | required | when the run started |
| `host` | text | required | the host it runs on |
| `id` | text, optional | — | the scheduler's job ID |
| `ranks` | text, optional | — | the ranks granted |
| `cores_per_rank` | text, optional | — | the cores per rank granted |
| `cores_on_node` | text, optional | — | the cores on the node granted |
| `gpus` | text, optional | — | the GPUs granted |
| `nodes` | text, optional | — | the nodes granted |
| `gpu_model` | text, optional | — | the GPU model the driver reports; no count |

## Ended

`ended.json`, written by the run script: how the command ended, or why the script stopped before its end — never on a stop signal (jobs.md § 4, blocks 6 and 14).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | integer | required | the command's exit status, or the script's own when it stopped before its end |
| `time` | text | required | when it ended |
| `reason` | text, optional | — | why it stopped before its end; null when it did not |

## Gone

`gone.json`, the job's word, written once by the first reader that finds the job over with no `ended.json` (jobs.md § 5.1).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `time` | text | required | when it was asked |
| `where` | text | required | the machine it was asked on |
| `found` | text | required | what it found |

## Cancelled

`cancel.json`, written by `job cancel` once its signal was sent (jobs.md § 5.4).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `time` | text | required | when the signal was sent |

## Checked

`checked.json`, the contract's verdict on what the command left, written by the check (jobs.md § 2; § 4, block 13), in the shape of the stage programs' documents (`femkit/engines/stages/documents.py`, `checked`), the one home of its fields.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schema` | integer | required | the documents' schema it was written at |
| `passed` | boolean | required | whether the check held |
| `reason` | text, optional | — | why it did not; null when passed |

## Outputs

`outputs.json`, written by the check once it passed: each output's SHA-256 (jobs.md § 2), in the shape of the stage programs' documents (`outputs`).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schema` | integer | required | the documents' schema it was written at |
| `files` | table of text → text | required | each output the request lists, with its SHA-256 |

## Address

`<state>/jobs/<id>.json`: one job launched from this machine (jobs.md § 5.4).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | text | required | what `job list` shows and `job cancel` names: `&lt;host&gt;-&lt;pid&gt;` for a job here |
| `how` | `background` \| `waited on` | required | how it went: here in the background, or here waited on: one of `background`, `waited on` |
| `host` | text | required | the host it was launched on: a process ID means something only there |
| `job` | [Job](#job) | required | its process: host, process ID, start time and boot ID |
| `folder` | text | required | the calculation or launch folder it was launched for |
| `runs` | list of text | empty | each run it started, by its path; a sequence's parts add theirs as they go |
| `sequence` | list of text, optional | — | for a sequence, each part in order, by its path |
| `time` | text | required | when it went |
